S.FORM: gaga utux Bbwan ro utux Gaga gaga na klhang kwe ga cn'rxan na utux gaga ro nya tna' mubuy gaga na utux Bbwan naha, baley ga utux sali, ini ga sa'ing sali ga musa utux na utux Gaga, piyux ga cn'rxan na msyow mpuw sali uy, lalu na mwah klahang gaga kwe ga mrhow na utux Bbwan. baley ci pntyagan na mrhow utux gaga kwe ga nya rmow tiyow yow na gaga snhyan ro gaga na Psani', kwara yow yhe, mrhow ga pyanga baley mwah ruruw mtiyow, kwara yow ptyagan nya ga yani ci: (1) mwah sbaley yow na cyoli wa hmiri'gaga, yani ci wa m'apal, tkruw cyoli, wa p'ilis cyoli, ttuwow, mulu yow, ini sble'iy yow ga ksa'ang ita Lutux bnkisan, ro phogan nya ita Tayal. (2) pgleng shri'an na utux Gaga ro yow na usa tmwang utux Gaga binah. (3) gaga utux Bbwan gmluw musa mluyak, musa Mgaga, iyat ga musa mtiri' paris, mrhow utux Gaga hiya ga musa mtama mrhow naha uy. (4) musa sbaley pc'unan na utux tnuxan.ro yow na hn'ilan mbahing. Bnrwan qa galan cpung 江明清Yawi‧Nomin, .
S.PHON: ɣaɣa utux ββwan ro utux ɣaɣa ɣaɣa na klħaŋ kwe ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]nʔrxan na utux ɣaɣa ro nja tnaʔ muβuj ɣaɣa na utux ββwan naħa βalej ɣa utux [s|ɕ]ali ini ɣa [s|ɕ]aʔiŋ [s|ɕ]ali ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a utux na utux ɣaɣa pijux ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]nʔrxan na m[s|ɕ]jow mpuw [s|ɕ]ali uj lalu na mwaħ klaħaŋ ɣaɣa kwe ɣa mrħow na utux ββwan βalej [ʦ|ʨ]i pntjaɣan na mrħow utux ɣaɣa kwe ɣa nja rmow tijow jow na ɣaɣa [s|ɕ]nħjan ro ɣaɣa na p[s|ɕ]aniʔ kwara jow jħe mrħow ɣa pjaŋa βalej mwaħ ruruw mtijow kwara jow ptjaɣan nja ɣa jani [ʦ|ʨ]i * mwaħ [s|ɕ]βalej jow na [ʦ|ʨ]joli wa ħmiriʔɣaɣa jani [ʦ|ʨ]i wa mʔapal tkruw [ʦ|ʨ]joli wa pʔili[s|ɕ] [ʦ|ʨ]joli ttuwow mulu jow ini [s|ɕ]βleʔij jow ɣa k[s|ɕ]aʔaŋ ita lutux βnki[s|ɕ]an ro pħoɣan nja ita tajal * pɣleŋ [s|ɕ]ħriʔan na utux ɣaɣa ro jow na u[s|ɕ]a tmwaŋ utux ɣaɣa βinaħ * ɣaɣa utux ββwan ɣmluw mu[s|ɕ]a mlujak mu[s|ɕ]a mɣaɣa ijat ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a mtiriʔ pari[s|ɕ] mrħow utux ɣaɣa ħija ɣa mu[s|ɕ]a mtama mrħow naħa uj * mu[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]βalej p[ʦ|ʨ]ʔunan na utux tnuxanro jow na ħnʔilan mβaħiŋ βnrwan qa ɣalan [ʦ|ʨ]puŋ ***jawinomin
